summary: Frontend-only i18n (AL/EN) feature test of ORBIX landing site on the public preview URL. Verified default Albanian on fresh localStorage, full EN switch across all 9 sections, switch back to AL, localStorage persistence across reload, bilingual contact form (placeholders, wa.me message encoding, confirmation text), bilingual WhatsApp float href, FAQ accordion in both languages, mobile 390x844 lang toggle + translated hamburger menu, no console/page errors, and production build. All 30+ assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: WhatsAppFloat visibility threshold is window.scrollY > 500 while the spec/test description says >600px — behaviour is fine but keep spec and code aligned.
i18n.jsx is ~283 lines of literal copy; if more languages are added, split translations into per-locale files to keep the provider thin.
seed_data_creation: None (no DB). Contact form filled with TEST QA / TEST Biz values; window.open stubbed so no external navigation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: i18n verified end-to-end. Read hero text via document.querySelector('[data-testid="hero-headline"]').innerText (split across spans). Section heading testids: services-heading, how-it-works-heading, niches-heading, why-orbix-heading, faq-heading, contact-heading, demo-heading, footer-copyright. Stub window.open before clicking contact-submit-button. Language key: localStorage 'orbix-lang' (al|en), document.documentElement.lang becomes sq/en. Production build 'GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false yarn build' exits 0 (~44s, main.js 129kB gz).
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found in this iteration.
